idea-plugin.name: PlantUML Markdown Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Renders PlantUML code blocks as UML diagrams in Markdown preview.

Supports plantuml and puml fenced code blocks.

Uses built-in Smetana layout engine, no Graphviz installation required.

Usage

Simply write PlantUML code in a fenced code block in your Markdown file:

```plantuml
Bob -> Alice : hello
```

The diagram will be rendered automatically in the Markdown preview panel.
